{{Quote|I found the caves of Skarok-Nur, Ludo Kressh's secret apprentice, didn't I? And it only took me three years.|Talos Drellik|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Skarok-Nur''' was the secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ludo Kressh]]. A cave system belonging to Skarok-Nur was discovered after three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of searching by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talos Drellik]].
